production.note: US model years 2013 to 2016. First: Jalopnik's "The 2013 Porsche Boxster Is Longer, Wider, Lighter, Better" (Matt Hardigree): "The new Boxster goes on sale in the U.S. early this summer with a starting price of $49,500 for the base model and $60,900 for the Boxster S"; PCNA lists the spec sheet pcna-2013-boxster-specs as "2013 Boxster and Boxster S" (pcna-technical-specifications-index). Last: kbb-2016-boxster lists a 2016 Boxster "S" with 315 hp and says "stay tuned for the more sophisticated 2017 Boxster", the turbocharged 718.

body.note: The Boxster is a two-seat open car with no fixed-roof version of the same model; the coupe is sold as the Cayman.

displacementL.note: 3,436 cc. Quote: "Displacement 2,706 cm3 3,436 cm3" (Boxster | Boxster S).

aspiration.note: Inferred: the spec sheet describes a water-cooled boxer six with no turbocharger or supercharger.

fuel.note: Inferred from the spec sheet's description of the boxer six; no hybrid system.

transmission.note: "Manual transmission 6-speed"; "Automatic transmission 7-speed PDK". DCT is Porsche PDK.

powerHp.note: Quote: "Maximum Horsepower 265 hp at 6,700 rpm 315 hp at 6,700 rpm" (Boxster | Boxster S). Still 315 hp for 2016 per kbb-2016-boxster.

weightLb.note: Roadster with the 6-speed manual. Quote: "Curb weight w/ manual 2,888 lbs. 2,910 lbs." (Boxster | Boxster S). PDK: "Curb weight w/ PDK 2,954 lbs. 2,976 lbs."
